title: Large Corner Condo-Skyline View - 10% of all stays
description:
Looking for a Nashville getaway less than 2 miles from downtown. Our cozy and stylish 1-bedroom 2nd floor condo offers 700 square feet of comfort and convenience, complete with a fully stocked kitchen, lots of natural light, and skyline views in the distance. 

The main bedroom has bathroom attached.  Bathroom is also accessible from the hallway.  The large living room/kitchen has a trundle bed with two twin beds, dining room, and well-stocked full kitchen for cooking and an extra sitting chair.

The space
This property is a corner unit with one bedroom, queen bed. The living area has well stocked kitchen, dining table, couch (trundle bed) and extra sitting chair. The trundle bed provides 2 twin beds for sleeping.

Guest access
Guests are given a code to the door prior to check-in.

Other things to note
The unit is on the second floor. Stairs are required as there is no elevator.
